events.what: Zeng claims a full affirmative proof that the first eigenvalue of every embedded minimal hypersurface of S^{n+1} is n
events.credibility_reason: F5 same-topic silence plus no uptake on a landmark problem: over a year with no citations, discussion or journal record, and both later preprints bounding exactly this eigenvalue (Zhao, arXiv:2603.20890; arXiv:2606.10962) still call the conjecture open and do not mention it. Counter-signal: the record says Zeng has worked on this conjecture for over a decade, so this is not an outsider claim; the call rests mainly on the successor papers' silence.

events.what: Zhao improves the Choi-Wang lower bound on the first eigenvalue
Improved lower bound on the first eigenvalue of embedded minimal hypersurfaces in the unit sphere

judgement.doubts: I agree with the 2026-09-24 hand correction's outcome, but not with all of its reasoning. Nothing in the record supports its claim that the variational method is one the problem is 'long resisted'. The not_credible call rests on same-topic silence and no uptake. It is weakened by Zeng being an established researcher in this subfield, so doubtful would also be defensible, which would make the status claimed. Zhao and arXiv:2606.10962 are both progress-tier bounds by humans, so either one gives the same codes.
